signals.evidence_basis: Static OTA tags plus Yahoo direct bodies repeatedly mention room semi-open-air bath, room bath, and 24-hour private use.
Room bath/ceramic tub language appears across Rakuten, Jalan, and Yahoo; the service value is private in-room bathing rather than a public bath circuit.
Keywords such as 温泉, 泉質, ツルツル, すべすべ, 肌 appear in direct bodies.
Direct reviews and official claims align that there is no public large bath; this is an expectation/positioning signal, not a public-bath satisfaction signal.
View/privacy keywords such as 海, 景色, 目隠し, 視線 appear; some praise room-view bathing while some note privacy or parking/road sightline expectations.
A small number of bodies imply ordinary-water/weak-feeling concern; not enough to outweigh the positive water-texture signal.
Mentions are mostly desire/request language such as wanting a reservable open-air bath; no separate private/family bath facility is treated as confirmed.
